_what: Recorded yells for the Playhouse's yell button. One is chosen at random on press.
_fallback: With none recorded the button falls back to the synthesised yell in love.js, so the toy works whether or not anybody has sent one — and the house rule on the page changes wording to match, because 'the noises are synthesised here, not fetched from anywhere' stops being true the moment a recording lands.
_consent: A voice identifies a person as surely as a face does, so this follows the polaroid wall's process. The yeller says how they want to be named, or asks to be anonymous. Withdrawal is deletion: remove the entry, remove the file, run the tool. Record only that consent exists and when — no contact details in a public repository.
_licence: A yell by anybody other than us carries NO onward licence. See LICENSE. CC BY-SA cannot be revoked and somebody who lends us their voice has to be able to take it back.
_files: audio/yells/<id>.m4a, or any format a recorder produces.
